rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved courses, Kansas Board-approved courses and courses approved by other state boards of pharmacy; pharmacist or technician CE both count, CE used for national certification renewal also counts
rules.alternatives: No CE waiver and no inactive status for technicians.
rules.audit_note: The Board audits 100% of technicians. Certificates for courses not in CPE Monitor must be sent to the Board within 30 days of completion; keep records for five years.
rules.notes: Registration renews every two years and expires Oct 31; hours must be earned within the registration period (e.g. Nov 1, 2024 - Oct 31, 2026). CPE Monitor hours are reported automatically. 1 CEU = 10 CE hours.
